firmware.description:
Please plug in charger to OTA upgrade when power is lower than 50%.

Update Version:
LK7k-16.3.0.150SP21(OP008PF001AZ)

Fixed Issues:
1. Optimized camera shutter response and burst shooting smoothness for a more seamless shooting experience.
2. Fixed the issue where swiping up to exit AI Gallery responded slowly, making exit gestures more responsive.
3. Optimized the disappearing animation for floating notifications to reduce stutter and make transitions smoother.
4. Fixed the issue where the notification shade responded slowly when swiping down, making interactions smoother.
5. Fixed the issue where swiping through the screenshot preview after taking a regular screenshot could stutter, so browsing screenshots is now smoother.
6. Optimized audio stability during calls in weak network conditions for clearer, more stable sound.
7. Fixed the issue where switching from Mobile Data to Wi-Fi could briefly interrupt connectivity in some scenarios, making network transitions smoother.
8. Fixed the issue where app icon badges did not appear on the home screen when messages were received, so important messages are less likely to be missed.
9. Fixed the issue where the ringtone icon in Control Center was displayed incompletely after switching to High Resolution mode, so icons now display properly.

Reminding:

2. Visit the TECNO SPOT forum (https://tspot.tecno.com) for more information.
